classification_error_summary.business_note: False Negatives carry higher revenue loss risk than False Positives; lowering probability alert threshold from 0.50 to 0.42 improves recall for high-CLV accounts.

limitations: Model features are anchored at historical cutoff (2025-12-31) without clickstream.
Enterprise accounts exhibit wider CLV variance, raising segment-level MAE vs SMB.
External macroeconomic indicators reflect annual GDP snapshots rather than quarterly.
